strategy.title: 5 Turning Points That Shaped Nature
strategy.hook: Five turning points reveal how a forest ecosystem became what we recognize today.

story_structure.opening: Start at the earliest recognizable state of a forest ecosystem with a clear time marker.
story_structure.escalation: Advance through five transformations, making the change between stages visually explicit.
story_structure.takeaway: End in the present with one clue about what may change next.

strategy.audience: Curious learners who save and share clear visual explanations.
strategy.visual_direction: Five-panel transformation timeline for a forest ecosystem; left-to-right progression, consistent subject silhouette, changing environment, distinct era cues, strong final-state emphasis
